payload.name: Search recommendation terms for shared-item queries
payload.description: When a question asks which items (movies, books, games) two or more people have both seen, read, or played, use recommendation-related searches because consuming an item recommended by another implies both have experienced it.
content: After searching each person with consumption terms (watched/read/played), also search each person's name with 'recommended'/'suggested' plus the item category; treat a memory that one person consumed an item on the other's recommendation as shared experience evidence.
Do not finalize the overlap list until recommendation-term searches have been tried, since the shared item may be recorded only as a recommendation-consumption event.

solves: Shared-experience answers were incomplete because recommendation-consumption memories were not searched; one person consuming an item recommended by the other implies both experienced it. Future queries asking what a pair/group both saw/read/played should include recommendation-oriented searches before finalizing, but not apply to questions solely about recommendations without consumption.
